comments.author: @yarini-1
comments.text: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean, not a "small island", it is actually the size of Pennsylvania. It produces the finest cigars in the world. Varadero Beach is among the nicest beaches worldwide. Cuban espresso coffee is truly the best of any other. Cuban women are among the prettiest in this hemisphere, in particular the mulatto women of Santiago de Cuba. Education in Cuba is paramount with 95% or more of its population being literate, compared to 67% in the USA.  The National dish of Cuba by Legislative Act, is Arroz con Pollo (Chicken with Yellow Rice. Cuba is by far the prettiest island in the Caribbean. is is truly the Pearl of the Caribbean.
